user.title: Shutter Pilot
user.description:
Shutter Pilot will be set up with three example areas. Location and sun times are taken from your Home Assistant settings automatically.

After setup, open **Shutter Pilot** in the sidebar to create your areas and assign your shutters.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Shutter Pilot is already set up. All areas and shutters are managed in the sidebar panel.

init.title: Shutter Pilot
init.description:
Everything is configured in the **Shutter Pilot** panel in the sidebar - areas, shutters, schedules and sun protection.

Currently configured: {area_count} areas, {shutter_count} shutters.

Just close this dialog and open the panel.
